node.statement: For U=sJ bold-dot(J+A+G(A)), involution and exact unitality give U^dagger=s(J-A+G(A)); hence ||U^dagger-sJ||<=||A||+||G(A)||<=(1+C_g*(epsilon_r+delta))*r. Adding the fixed closeness bound and using the receiving chart-retention guard by monotonicity yields ||W-sJ||<(1+epsilon_r)*(1+C_g*(epsilon_r+delta))*r+G_c*epsilon_r<2delta.
